ladder.name: Great, no Cup
ladder.text: The simplest definition of bad luck: you were great, and you never won the Cup. Career point shares count only if the Cup count is zero.

ladder.name: Cups expected vs won
ladder.text: Every season, his team gets its fair share of that year's Cup based on how good it was in the regular season. Expected Cups minus Cups won.

ladder.name: Bodies
ladder.text: How much of his prime, age 22 to 31, he actually got to play. The average player in the pool lost about 9%.

ladder.name: The dynasty tax
ladder.text: Every season that ended against the eventual champion, with extra weight for dynasties and for losing in the Final.

ladder.name: Bounces
ladder.text: Series lost in the last possible game (double if by one goal), plus playoff goals lost because his team's shooters and goalies went cold.

ladder.name: Circumstances
ladder.text: Weak teammates, 2nd-place award finishes, and bad timing: a team that just got rid of him wins the Cup.
